name: Grav MCP
description: Private MCP companion for Grav 2.0 with the Grav API plugin enabled. The MCP HTTP transport has no built-in client authentication. This store's Grav app is 1.8.0, an unsupported beta line, so this companion will not work with it until Grav is migrated to 2.0.
author: getgrav

form_fields.label: Grav API URL
form_fields.hint: Grav 2.0 API URL, usually ending in /api.
